items.excerpt: For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.placer.ai/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
To use PAPI, you need a paying Placer account and have the Placer API add-on enabled.
Contact your customer success manager to provide you with an API Key.
Each Placer account has its own usage plan, including the costs of issuing API calls, and the maximum weekly quota.
The Placer API allows developers and data analysts to extract Placer’s location analytics programmatically for use in a variety of 3rd party applications.
This service returns a list of Placer managed entities in a particular area.
items.note: Search for Placer Entities endpoint (POI search by area); endpoint list also includes custom POI create, update and delete.

items.excerpt: Placer MCP is an enterprise feature and must be enabled per account to access.
An AI assistant that supports remote MCP servers over streamable HTTP with OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and others).
